sheets.use: the pumping station and its puzzles: valve wheels, levers, plates, gauges, pumps and tanks, the pump housing, the pipe map and its torn pieces, the plaque and the old photo (not cut yet)
sheets.note: 8 rows, cut into 90 sprites (tools/cut_sheets.py). Missing: "map piece 2" (three of the four pieces are there) and the separate "pump housing" (the story's fuel tank: the three "tank" canisters are the nearest thing). The model moved "wrench", "big wrench" and "oil can" up to the lights row. The piston caps and the tanks' sight glass are tinted pink; the ladders keep pink specks between the rungs.

sheets.title: Bubbling Moon backgrounds, outdoors 1: the sky with the broken Milky Way (top panel) and the far cheese mountains (bottom panel)
sheets.source: Claude, through the image API (gpt-image-2.6-flare, high; tools/sheets.mjs)
sheets.use: the slowest background layers outdoors: each panel is two screens wide (3840 x 1080), the sky is opaque, the mountains stand on magenta (not cut yet)
sheets.note: Two panels of 3840 x 1080 picture pixels (960 x 270 game pixels). Cut as sky.png and far-mountains.png (keyed) by `cut_sheets.py --panels <folder>`, which are not stored twice in the repository. The sky's left and right edges almost meet (difference 1.5 of 255); the mountains' do not (27).

sheets.title: Bubbling Moon backgrounds, outdoors 2: the middle plain with the far pumping station (top panel) and the near cliffs and pipes (bottom panel)
sheets.source: Claude, through the image API (gpt-image-2.6-flare, high; tools/sheets.mjs)
sheets.use: the middle and near layers outdoors, on magenta (not cut yet)
sheets.note: Two panels of 3840 x 1080 picture pixels: middle-plain.png and near-cliffs.png (`cut_sheets.py --panels <folder>`). The seams do not meet yet (edge difference 16 and 37 of 255), so they need a blend to repeat.
